lines: We made camp under the trees, far from the city.
Nobody said much. The fire kept going out.
Yuna prayed like always. I don't think it helped.
Bevelle was shut to us after that.
So we went the only way left. The Calm Lands.

dboxTimeline.text: The bells were still going when we reached the steps.
They had rifles on us. She put her staff down.
He kissed her. Then he told them to shoot us.
She stepped off the edge, and Valefor caught her.
I thought that was the end of it. It wasn't close.
They tried us in a room full of the dead.
Then they dropped us in the dark to get rid of us.
The water tasted like rust. We swam out anyway.
We found each other at the bridge. All of us.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Rikku
dboxTimeline.text: Yunie! You're okay! You're okay, right?

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: I'm all right. I'm sorry I made you worry.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Wakka
dboxTimeline.text: Nobody's okay. But everybody's here, ya?

dboxTimeline.speaker: Auron
dboxTimeline.text: Kinoc.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Seymour
dboxTimeline.text: He was afraid, so I gave him rest. It was a kindness.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Seymour
dboxTimeline.text: Spira only knows how to hurt, Lady Yuna.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Seymour
dboxTimeline.text: Come to Zanarkand with me. I will end all of it.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Tidus
dboxTimeline.text: End it how? By becoming the thing that eats it?

dboxTimeline.speaker: Seymour
dboxTimeline.text: By becoming the only mercy Spira has left.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Kimahri
dboxTimeline.text: Yuna goes. Kimahri stays.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Auron
dboxTimeline.text: Go. Now.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Lulu
dboxTimeline.text: Yuna. Come.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: He is my guardian.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Tidus
dboxTimeline.text: Then so are we. All of us.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Auron
dboxTimeline.text: Hmph.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Tidus
dboxTimeline.text: Stop talking. You never say anything.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Seymour
dboxTimeline.text: Then listen, son of Jecht. It is almost over.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Auron
dboxTimeline.text: Kinoc was my friend once. Fool that he was.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Seymour
dboxTimeline.text: He thanked me, at the end. Ask him yourself.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: You belong on the Farplane. I'll send you there.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Seymour
dboxTimeline.text: Then you will have to catch me, Lady Yuna.
We made camp under the trees, far from the city.
Nobody said much. The fire kept going out.
Yuna prayed like always. I don't think it helped.
Bevelle was shut to us after that.
So we went the only way left. The Calm Lands.
